However, section 6 of the interface spec and section 5 of the microarchitecture both call for unbounded SymbiYosys proofs at WIDTH 8 and 1, so that work is still open and should be scheduled as a follow-up task. The testbench sets WIDTH 1 data to bit 0 of the WIDTH 8 stream and drives both instances with the same handshakes. Data offered while the slice is full is deliberately different from the next accepted beat, which checks that refused beats are not taken. Under Verilator's default error limit, the first $error may stop the run before the verdict line prints. That run still counts as failed.
